lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਘਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saach sahaj sobhaa ghanee har gun naam adhaar ||
lines.translation: Through truth and intuitive poise, great honor is obtained, with the Support of the Naam and the Glory of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu rakh too(n) mai tujh bin kavan bhataar ||3||
lines.translation: As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me. Without You, O my Husband Lord, who else is there for me? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭੁਲੀਐ ਭੇਖੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: akhar paR paR bhuleeai bhekhee bahut abhimaan ||
lines.translation: Reading their books over and over again, people continue making mistakes; they are so proud of their religious robes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: teerath naataa kiaa kare man mahi mail gumaan ||
lines.translation: But what is the use of bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, when the filth of stubborn pride is within the mind?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin kin samajhaaeeai man raajaa sulataan ||4||
lines.translation: Other than the Guru, who can explain that within the mind is the Lord, the King, the Emperor? ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: prem padaarath paaeeai guramukh tat veechaar ||
lines.translation: The Treasure of the Lord's Love is obtained by the Gurmukh, who contemplates the essence of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa dhan aap gavaaiaa gur kai sabad seegaar ||
lines.translation: The bride eradicates her selfishness, and adorns herself with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ghar hee so pir paaiaa gur kai het apaar ||5||
lines.translation: Within her own home, she finds her Husband, through infinite love for the Guru. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee sevaa chaakaree man niramal sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: Applying oneself to the service of the Guru, the mind is purified, and peace is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad man vasiaa haumai vichahu khoi ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and egotism is eliminated from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath paaiaa laabh sadaa man hoi ||6||
lines.translation: The Treasure of the Naam is acquired, and the mind reaps the lasting profit. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਲਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam milai taa paaeeai aap na laiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: If He grants His Grace, then we obtain it. We cannot find it by our own efforts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee charanee lag rahu vichahu aap gavaai ||
lines.translation: Remain attached to the Feet of the Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sache setee ratiaa sacho palai paai ||7||
lines.translation: Attuned to Truth, you shall obtain the True One. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੁਲਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhulan a(n)dar sabh ko abhul guroo karataar ||
lines.translation: Everyone makes mistakes; only the Guru and the Creator are infallible.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat man samajhaaiaa laagaa tisai piaar ||
lines.translation: One who instructs his mind with the Guru's Teachings comes to embrace love for the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saach na veesarai mele sabad apaar ||8||12||
lines.translation: O Nanak, do not forget the Truth; you shall receive the Infinite Word of the Shabad. ||8||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਘਰ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa maaiaa mohanee sut ba(n)dhap ghar naar ||
lines.translation: The enticing desire for Maya leads people to become emotionally attached to their children, relatives, households and spouses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan joban jag thagiaa lab lobh aha(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: The world is deceived and plundered by riches, youth, greed and egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: moh thagaulee hau muee saa varatai sa(n)saar ||1||
lines.translation: The drug of emotional attachment has destroyed me, as it has destroyed the whole world. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere preetamaa mai tujh bin avar na koi ||
lines.translation: O my Beloved, I have no one except You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai tujh bin avar na bhaavaee too(n) bhaavahi sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without You, nothing else pleases me. Loving You, I am at peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam saalaahee ra(n)g siu gur kai sabad sa(n)tokh ||
lines.translation: I sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with love; I am content with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਕੂੜਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so chalasee kooRaa mohu na vekh ||
lines.translation: Whatever is seen shall pass away. So do not be attached to this false show.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਆਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਦਾ ਸਾਥੁ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vaat vataaoo aaiaa nit chaladaa saath dekh ||2||
lines.translation: Like a traveller in his travels, you have come. Behold the caravan leaving each day. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aakhan aakhahi ketaRe gur bin boojh na hoi ||
lines.translation: Many preach sermons, but without the Guru, understanding is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਪੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam vadaaee je milai sach rapai pat hoi ||
lines.translation: If someone receives the Glory of the Naam, he is attuned to truth and blessed with honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavahi se bhale khotaa kharaa na koi ||3||
lines.translation: Those who are pleasing to You are good; no one is counterfeit or genuine. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur saranaaee chhuteeai manamukh khotee raas ||
lines.translation: In the Guru's Sanctuary we are saved. The assets of the self-willed manmukhs are false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਕੀ ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: asat dhaat paatisaah kee ghaReeai sabad vigaas ||
lines.translation: The eight metals of the King are made into coins by the Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aape parakhe paarakhoo pavai khajaanai raas ||4||
lines.translation: The Assayer Himself assays them, and He places the genuine ones in His Treasury. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree keemat naa pavai sabh dithee thok vajaai ||
lines.translation: Your Value cannot be appraised; I have seen and tested everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੈ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਸਚਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahanai haath na labhaee sach tikai pat paai ||
lines.translation: By speaking, His Depth cannot be found. Abiding in truth, honor is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: guramat too(n) saalaahanaa hor keemat kahan na jaai ||5||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, I praise You; otherwise, I cannot describe Your Value. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit tan naam na bhaavaee tit tan haumai vaad ||
lines.translation: That body which does not appreciate the Naam-that body is infested with egotism and conflict.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin giaan na paaeeai bikhiaa doojaa saad ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained; other tastes are poison.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੀਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: bin gun kaam na aavaee maaiaa pheekaa saad ||6||
lines.translation: Without virtue, nothing is of any use. The taste of Maya is bland and insipid. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਆਸਾ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa a(n)dar ja(n)miaa aasaa ras kas khaai ||
lines.translation: Through desire, people are cast into the womb and reborn. Through desire, they taste the sweet and sour flavors.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ba(n)dh chalaaeeai muhe muhi chotaa khaai ||
lines.translation: Bound by desire, they are led on, beaten and struck on their faces and mouths.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਬਧਾ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: avagan badhaa maareeai chhootai guramat naai ||7||
lines.translation: Bound and gagged and assaulted by evil, they are released only through the Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||7||
